name: Sound Recorder
tagline: A simple, modern sound recorder for GNOME
blurb: Sound Recorder provides a simple and modern interface that provides a straight-forward way to record and play audio.
description:
Sound Recorder provides a simple and modern interface that provides a
straight-forward way to record and play audio.
It allows you to do basic editing, and create voice memos.

Sound Recorder automatically handles the saving process so that you
do not need to worry about accidentally discarding the previous recording.

Supported audio formats:

• Ogg Vorbis, Opus, FLAC, MP3 and MOV

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
